latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Converter MOV to MP4 — fast, cloud-based MOV-to-MP4 conversion.

- Upload MOV, MP4, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB and convert them to 1080p MP4.
- Designed for iPhone/Mac users and creators needing quick uploads to platforms like YouTube.
- Guided workflow: connect, upload, describe your edit, and download the result.
- Automatic backend session and token management for both registered and anonymous users.
- Supports prompt-driven actions (convert/export/status) with clear error handling and helpful tips.
- All processing and rendering handled server-side—no installation required.
